cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A copies the outward signs of taking charge without understanding them, then seeks B explicit public transfer of decision power.
confusable: D57 seeks respect for rank; D60 specifically transfers who decides what happens next.
comparison: Outgoing hall custodian versus meeting chair handover.
seedUse: Use an immediate dance decision or room announcement rather than abstract succession explanation.
